biography:
Results-driven real estate executive with a proven track record of success in acquisitions, development, and asset management across diverse property types, including large-scale mixed-use projects. I bring over 15 years of experience in identifying and executing value-add and opportunistic investment strategies in dynamic markets across the US. My expertise spans the full spectrum of the real estate lifecycle, from underwriting and due diligence to financial analysis, debt and equity financings, and project execution. I have a strong history of collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional results and exceed investment objectives.

At Google, I currently serve as a Data Center Strategic Negotiator, Acquisitions & Development, driving Google's global data center expansion by securing critical infrastructure and resources. Identify, define, and pursue new site expansion projects and initiatives, ensuring a robust pipeline of development-ready sites.

Previously at Google, I led financial analysis and strategic recommendations to maximize cash flow and appreciation for their ambitious mixed-use development projects in Silicon Valley. This involved a portfolio with the potential for 20,000 residential units, 20 million square feet of office space, and 1 million square feet of retail. I analyzed property and portfolio operating data, developed sophisticated financial models to assess investment returns and feasibility, and structured joint ventures to optimize project delivery.  My role also included evaluating a range of portfolio and asset-level solutions, such as joint ventures, sale-leasebacks, and ground leases, considering their business, P&L, and legal implications. I consistently collaborated with cross-functional teams, including planning, legal, and accounting, to drive decision-making and present findings to leadership.

Prior to Google, I held key roles at leading organizations such as The Peebles Corporation, Red Stone Partners, TGM Associates, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, and Deloitte & Touche LLP, where I honed my skills in financial modeling, deal structuring, and market analysis. I am passionate about creating value through strategic real estate investments and am seeking a challenging opportunity where I can leverage my expertise to drive growth and innovation.

Key areas of expertise:

Acquisitions & Dispositions
Real Estate Development (Multifamily, Condominium, Office, Hotel, Retail)
Financial Modeling & Analysis
Due Diligence & Underwriting
Market Research & Valuation
Joint Venture Structuring
Asset Management
